faqLeft.q: What engine does the Jaguar XF R-Sport use?
faqLeft.a: It varies. The X260-generation R-Sport was offered with the Ingenium 2.0L petrol (AJ200), the Ingenium 2.0L diesel (AJ200D), and – on earlier cars – the AJ126 3.0L supercharged V6. Enter your registration and we'll identify your exact engine.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar XF R-Sport engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,000 for 2.0-litre petrol and diesel units, and from £3,200 for the 3.0-litre V6. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my XF R-Sport?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the AJ200, AJ200D, or AJ126 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ200 petrol XF R-Sport engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard on every rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ200D diesel XF R-Sport engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, tensioners, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every diesel rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you rebuild AJ126 V6 XF R-Sport engines?
faqRight.a: Yes. The AJ126 is serviced to the same high standard as our other Jaguar V6 rebuilds.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used XF R-Sport engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my XF R-Sport if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an XF R-Sport engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most XF R-Sport owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
